title: The Matching Principle: A Geometric Theory of Loss Functions for Nuisance-Robust Representation Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Word Error Rate (WER) and geometric embedding drift (Trajectory Deviation Index) of the Whisper-small speech recognition model under accent and speaker variations using the LibriSpeech-other dataset.
Measuring the rate at which an LLM (Qwen2.5-7B) falsely agrees with a user's prompt across different style rewrites, comparing raw sycophantic behavior against honest preference in model alignment.
Evaluating image classification accuracy and representational sensitivity under various synthetic visual corruptions (e.g., Gaussian noise, blur, weather) using the ImageNet-C benchmark.
